chapters.reason: TreeBoN integrates speculative tree-search into Best-of-N sampling, generating multiple candidates concurrently and pruning low-quality paths, which directly aligns with the Parallel Search category's focus on tree-search pruning and Best-of-N variants.

The paper enhances inference-time alignment by scaling compute dynamically via search width (parallel sampling) and uses iterative tree expansion, fitting the Efficient Test-time Scaling and Infinity Thinking category's focus on parallel sampling and balancing search depth/width.

TreeBoN employs a speculative tree-search strategy that involves branching and pruning, which shares conceptual similarities with speculative decoding techniques mentioned in Model Switch, though it operates within a single model framework rather than distinct separate models.
